items.title: Expanding Amazon’s Supply Chain Capabilities for SAP Customers: Multi-Channel Fulfillment Accelerator
items.summary: In May 2026, Amazon brought the reliability, resilience, and convenience of its supply chain capabilities along with the network and technology behind it under one logistics system and name: Amazon Supply Chain Services (ASCS). First built for Amazon, then extended to sellers, now for all businesses and sales channels. Amazon Multi-Channel Fulfillment (MCF) is a […]
